instruction: Navigate to the Chrome settings area where you can manage languages and input methods.

metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating to Chrome language settings. Uses existing is_expected_active_tab_approximate metric to check if the active tab URL matches chrome://settings/languages. Similar complexity to original task - single navigation action to Chrome internal settings page.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator logic correctly verifies the instruction requirement: navigating to Chrome language settings page
Getter 'get_active_url_from_accessTree' can reliably extract the active Chrome tab URL from the accessibility tree
Metric 'is_expected_active_tab_approximate' appropriately compares URLs while ignoring query parameters, allowing for minor URL variations
Expected value 'chrome://settings/languages' is semantically correct - this is the exact Chrome internal URL for language and input method settings
Data flow is correct: getter extracts URL string → metric compares with expected URL → returns 1.0 if match
goto_prefix config is correctly set to empty string for chrome:// URLs (Chrome address bar shows full protocol)
No postconfig needed - Chrome settings are accessible at any time without special UI state requirements
